text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good! I have nothing more to teach you. 
You all did a wonderful job!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Heart! As expected, your 
lessons are just so easy to follow~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! What a coincidence seeing you 
here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yep! The dance style I learned in America 
has gotten pretty popular, so I'm 
sometimes asked to give lessons.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I want to help my friends, and teaching 
also leads to my own growth. That's why I 
always tell them they can ask me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, flattery won't get you anywhere, you 
know? Well then, it's about time I get 
changed—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yeah! Accelerate with super sparkly 
buffs! Then land a critical hit of 
courage!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Is that voice... Kawakami-san...? I 
wonder if she's practicing for the stage."
choice_data_list: Still, was there ever a song like that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, why don't we go take a peek? I 
have a feeling we might learn something!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Fufufu♪ Take a look. Don't you think my 
steps are already absolute perfection!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Way to go, Kawakami! All right, next time 
I'll join in too—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! That's such a lovely dance, 
Kawakami-san!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Graceful and lovely like a princess, yet 
powerful like a fighter... Where on earth 
did you learn to dance like that?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My! So you are interested in dancing! In 
that case, allow me to teach you. This 
dance is, quite simply—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's the ending dance from one of the 
PriFai series, "Heart Brave♡PriFai"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
PriFigh... If I recall correctly, that was 
an anime Pandora liked, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To think that such incredible dancing 
existed even in the world of animation...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san, this dance is wonderful! 
Please give me some guidance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
M-Me as the Queen of Hearts...? Why, of 
course, I would be delighted to!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What's with barging in like that? I 
was dancing with Kawakami first!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry. You're right. But... I can't 
give up either.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Please, Sweep, won't you let me join too? 
In the world of PreFie that you all bring 
to life!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that wonderful! After all, this ED 
was originally meant to showcase the three 
Precutes dancing in perfect sync.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Having Heart-san join us makes the ending 
recreation even more accurate, bringing 
out the character's charm splendidly!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it can't be helped. But I will 
NE~VER give up the Witch Princess 
position!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, both of you! Since you're 
teaching me, I promise to make this the 
best dance ever!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then right off the bat— where do you think 
I should focus my dance moves for this 
Pre-Fi dance, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's the kind of cuteness that 
charms everyone who sees it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! The secret of PreFighters lies 
in splendid strength!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's dance as if to blow everything 
away, shall we?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What passion! And yet you never 
forget to be cute, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let myself be outdone either! I 
have to approach this with heart too!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What, if you want to know about charming 
magic, I can teach you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If I use everything from my fingertips and 
gaze down to the flow of my hair, I can 
make the whole world my servant!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How cute! That's our Sweep, so this is 
what your magic can do!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Direct their gazes... like this! Hehe, 
it'll make for some wonderful magic♪
